title: LEGO PlayStation Price, Release Date and 1,911-Piece Set Details
description: The 1,911-piece LEGO PlayStation recreates Sony’s original console and controller. Here are the price, October release dates and availability details.
body:
Sony and the LEGO Group have turned the original PlayStation into a 1,911-piece display set that recreates both the console and its controller at close to real-world scale.

The LEGO PlayStation launches first on October 1, 2026 through PlayStation Direct in supported markets and through LEGO Insiders Early Access. Wider LEGO.com and LEGO Store availability begins October 4.

The recommended price is $179.99 in the US, €159.99 in Europe and £139.99 in the UK.
author: Rouane Mounssif
imageAlt: LEGO model of the original gray PlayStation console with a wired LEGO controller on a wooden table.

contentBlocks.text: Sony lists the LEGO PlayStation at **$179.99 / €159.99 / £139.99 / ¥27,980**. It becomes available through **PlayStation Direct on October 1, 2026** in supported markets. LEGO Insiders also get Early Access on October 1, while broader availability through LEGO.com and LEGO Stores begins **October 4**.
contentBlocks.heading: LEGO PlayStation price and release date

contentBlocks.text: The set uses **1,911 pieces** and is designed as a near-1:1-scale recreation of the original PlayStation console. Sony says the completed model measures **10.5 inches / 26 cm wide**. The build also includes a LEGO version of the original PlayStation controller that can connect to the console model.
contentBlocks.heading: How big is the LEGO PlayStation set?

contentBlocks.text: The model is not only an exterior shell. Sony and LEGO included references to two games associated with the original PlayStation era: **Ape Escape** and **Gran Turismo**. Each gets a small removable diorama, with the Gran Turismo display featuring a miniature track and cars while the Ape Escape scene includes a small island setup. The console’s Power and Open buttons also have functional mechanisms.
contentBlocks.heading: Ape Escape and Gran Turismo are hidden inside the nostalgia

contentBlocks.text: PlayStation Direct availability on October 1 covers supported markets including the US, UK and several European countries. LEGO Insiders can access the set from the same date, while the general LEGO retail window starts October 4. That means buyers who do not use PlayStation Direct or LEGO Insiders should treat October 4 as the broad release date.
contentBlocks.heading: Where will LEGO PlayStation be sold?

conclusion: The LEGO PlayStation is unusually easy to understand as a product: it is a large display-focused recreation of Sony’s first console with functional details and two small game-history dioramas. The main buying questions are price, October availability and whether buyers need LEGO Insiders access for the earliest window.
